children.role_in_glue: The assembly glue applies it to every smooth approximating potential, obtaining its normalizer, Gaussian map, matrix field and affine entropy-gap identity.

notes: Six new children and three reused shared inputs o005/o006/o007. The proved Assembly.lean glue applies approximation, chooses normalized transports, transfers the exact density and deficit identities, and applies centered_slack_transports to their raw data. No Section 2--5 result is repeated or inferred from lower_bound alone. The general matrix step of Lemma 6.2 is included from x0007 as the locally checked owned Frobenius.lean; only scalar Gaussian hazard Lipschitz remains a child. Accepted EntropyTools supplies covariance positivity. Every new and reused theorem is used by the final proof.
